## Device and platform profiles

- [Apple Watch / HealthKit](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/apple-watch-healthkit.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): ECG, AF and hypertension notifications, HRV
- [Fitbit / Google](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/fitbit-google.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): ECG, irregular rhythm, HRV, Fitbit Heart Study
- [Movesense](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/movesense.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): Single-lead ECG and RR interval access
- [Polar](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/polar.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): H10 ECG strap, HR and RR interval access
- [Samsung](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/samsung.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): ECG and blood pressure on Galaxy Watch
- [Withings](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/withings.md) (Module 1 profile, primary): ScanWatch ECG, blood pressure cuff
- [CARP Mobile Sensing](../../module-02-digital-phenotyping/profiles/carp-mobile-sensing.md) (Module 2 profile, secondary): Polar and Movesense ECG, PPI and HR integrations
- [Emerging platforms](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/emerging-platforms.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Includes Verily Study Watch ECG, raw PPG and IBI exports
- [Empatica](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/empatica.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): Raw PPG and IBI, pulse rate variability
- [Garmin](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/garmin.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): ECG app, enhanced BBI, blood pressure via Health API
- [Oura](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/oura.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): HR and HRV time series; no ECG
- [WHOOP](../../module-01-wearables/profiles/whoop.md) (Module 1 profile, secondary): HRV and RHR core; no raw IBI; ECG on MG
